findings: Builder.Build ignores the workflow history parameter (context.go:53), indicating incomplete integration or dead code.

The Section struct defines advanced context management fields like Sticky, RetentionMode, and RefreshEveryTurns (context.go:22-33), but none are consumed by the Builder or trimming logic, suggesting unimplemented features or schema drift.

trimMessages implements a sliding window that prioritizes the latest user message as an anchor. Tests (context_test.go:24-40) reveal that intermediate tool calls are entirely dropped if the window is tight, which may break multi-step reasoning chains that rely on tool outputs.
RepoContextCache lacks session scoping (repo.go:23-27), risking cross-session contamination if the cache instance is shared across concurrent agents.

gitSummary and scanRepo execute synchronous filesystem walks and git commands without timeouts or context cancellation (repo.go:121, repo.go:215), which can block the inference loop on large repositories or slow I/O.
InteractionTurnCount (repo.go:107) performs an O(N) linear scan of all history records on every invocation. This should be cached or maintained incrementally to avoid repeated overhead.

HashContent exports a SHA1 hasher (context.go:237), which is cryptographically deprecated and computationally expensive for cache keys. A faster non-cryptographic hash (e.g., FNV or xxhash) would be more appropriate.
